title: Dispatch: olc5.11 repair after cloud review r3 S1-S3 (attempt 4)
description:
Repair PR #663 (eshyra-olc5.11) after cloud final review r3 at bf8e2958: CHANGES REQUESTED (3). Branch eshyra-olc5.11.4 from eshyra-olc5.11 at bf8e2958. Review r3 confirmed all 13 READY operations faithful and the r3 removals clean; the 3 findings are the same owner-vs-other-creature class on fail-closed (engine-pending) kept machines. Fix each finding AND sweep the whole class once more.

GOVERNING PRINCIPLE (unchanged from attempt 3): an action taken by the ITEM'S OWNER/USER is an operation executed through use_item (with its typed cost). An action or event of ANOTHER creature, or of any creature when the source says "a creature", or an external spell/effect, is NOT the owner's operation: it is an external condition transition carrying the full verbatim printed predicate, fired by item_state_event (no owner cost); the DM charges that creature's own action separately with spend_turn_resource.

S1 magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts ~728 Rod of Alertness: source "The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes, or when a creature uses an action to pull the rod from the ground." "a creature" = any creature (owner included), so the owner-charged pull-rod operation is wrong. Closure: remove op('pull-rod') and its via transition; add planted-aura -> held external condition carrying the full verbatim predicate ("when a creature uses an action to pull the rod from the ground"). Keep the 10-minute timer. Check every consumer/test of pull-rod.

S2 magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts ~455 Immovable Rod: source "Until you or another creature uses an action to push the button again, the rod doesn't move". The owner's release-rod operation stays (the "you" path). Closure: ADD an external condition fixed -> released (whatever the toggle's state ids are) carrying the full predicate for the other-creature path ("another creature uses an action to push the button again"). Also: "A creature can use an action to make a DC 30 Strength check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 feet on a success." is currently only inside the termination string and that sentence does NOT release the rod (it moves it while still fixed) - make sure the generated record carries it verbatim as an adjudicated clause / non-terminating external event, NOT as a termination and NOT as an owner operation. "More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall." stays an external condition.

S3 magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts ~250 (+ magicItemChargeEconomies.ts ~98) Cube of Force spell-contact-loss: the barrier being targeted by / contacting listed spells or effects is an external event, the same class as the removed Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning. Closure: remove op('spell-contact-loss') from both the operation list and the charge economy operation list; re-express the face-N self-loops as external condition transitions carrying the full verbatim predicate ("The cube loses charges when the barrier is targeted by certain spells or comes into contact with certain spell or magic item effects, as shown in the table below.") with effect m5-complex-cube-contact (table:cube-of-force-charges-lost). If the typed external-event path cannot deduct charges, do NOT invent a mechanism: keep the charge loss fail-closed engine-pending with the verbatim clause and report exactly what is missing. Keep the "runs out of charges" condition.

SIBLING SWEEP (required, final): for EVERY operation of all 21 kept machines in the GENERATED pack, quote the printed sentence that authorizes it and state whose action it is (owner / another creature / any creature / external effect). Any operation not exclusively the owner's action is converted per the principle. Also re-confirm every condition transition carries a full (not fragment) printed predicate with no duplicates. Do not change the 13 READY operations unless the sweep finds a source-backed defect; report the ready set before/after (expected unchanged at 13).

Regenerate the pack (npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/), npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack, regenerate + --check the semi-structured inventory, update the termination census, update the records.json hash in the thaw note if the pack changes, update count expectations only with source-backed justification. Add generated-pack assertions (not projection-only) for each of S1-S3. Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: per-finding closure, the full per-operation ownership table from the sweep, condition sweep result, exact ready-operation set before/after.
notes:
USER AUTHORIZED 2026-10-14: proceed with this repair now (stop condition after review r3 surfaced and decided: continue with Luna implementing; the user reviews the PR). Implement per plan.
Dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high from bf8e2958; PGID 5092.

COMPLETION REPORT — committed as 33b28970 on eshyra-olc5.11.4 (feature branch handoff; not pushed).

Finding closures:
- S1 Rod of Alertness: removed owner operation pull-rod; planted-aura -> held is now an item_state_event condition carrying the exact predicate “when a creature uses an action to pull the rod from the ground”. The 10-minute timer remains unchanged.
- S2 Immovable Rod: retained owner operation release-rod for the “you” path; added active -> inactive external condition “another creature uses an action to push the button again”. Added a fixed -> fixed external condition with the full DC 30 Strength-check sentence; it does not release the rod. “More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall.” remains an external condition. The DC 30 clause is absent from termination.
- S3 Cube of Force: removed spell-contact-loss from the complex operation list, charge-economy operation list, and faithful-operation census. Each active face has a self-loop condition containing the full printed charge-loss sentence and effect m5-complex-cube-contact/table:cube-of-force-charges-lost. Charge deduction cannot execute: item_state_event accepts instanceId/condition/character and applies a declared state transition, but has no event context or economy-mutation input and does not execute the effect/table to deduct charges. No mechanism was invented; the exact event stays fail-closed under the engine-pending m5-complex-cube-of-force clause (missing F2/F5/F9 hooks). Follow-up filed: eshyra-olc5.13.

Full operation ownership sweep — all 21 kept machines. Each grouped row lists every operation governed by the quoted sentence; every item action/choice is the item owner/user. No operation is an action of another creature or an external spell/effect. Other-creature/any-creature/external effects are condition transitions, not owner operations.

Condition sweep: all condition predicates across the 21 generated machines are exact substrings of the printed item description; no duplicate condition exists for the same source state. Repeated Cube contact/charge clauses occur once per distinct face state; Rope destruction clauses occur once per distinct source state. S1-S3 conditions retain the complete governing predicate/sentence; the DC 30 check is a self-loop on the fixed state, and Cube charge loss remains non-executable pending event-economy support.

Ready-operation set before/after is exactly unchanged (13): Ammunition, +1, +2, or +3/hit-target; Animated Shield/end-animation, speak-command-word; Boots of Levitation/cast-levitate; Candle of Invocation/burn; Frost Brand/extinguish-flames; Ring of X-ray Vision/activate-x-ray-vision; Rod of Security/enter-paradise; Rope of Entanglement/entangle-creature, release-creature; Well of Many Worlds/open-portal; Wings of Flying/dismiss-wings, manifest-wings.

Counts: generated operations 359 -> 357 (removal of the two non-owner event operations); readiness clauses 1378 -> 1376 and engine-pending hooks 793 -> 792; adjudicated clauses 361 -> 360. The exact Census/backlog/packet expectations were updated for these source-backed removals. Machine count stays 21; no operation in the ready set changed.
